Bob Bailey appears in 526 recordings across 5 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1946 to 1960. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Bob Bailey most often in Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar, Let George Do It, Lux Radio Theatre, Screen Directors Playhouse, and The Line Up.

Characters credited here include Johnny Dollar and George Valentine.
